notes.title: Summer update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

This time I got a handful of features & fixes. There are updates to weapons, items, options and game feedback.

[b]Weapon changes:[/b]
All reload times are cut by 35% to make reloading less annoying.
Shotguns can now be upgraded with "extended range" at the shop.
The hit detection for ray weapons is revised and should now be more "fair" towards the player.
"Chance to heal on kill" 1hp at 25% -> 5hp at 10%.

[b]New items:[/b]
Add "Seeker rounds" item.
Add "Plutonium rounds" item.
Add "Blast shield" item.

[b]Options changes:[/b]
A new panel where where you can customize the crosshair. This lets you change color, style and size of the crosshair.
Add option to toggle camera shake on/off.


[b]Feedback changes:[/b]
Buffs & de-buffs now show up as icons next to the health bar.
Enemy fire projectiles are now more red to make them stand out more from the player projectiles.
Add gain bullet indicator over head (triggered from weapon upgrade).
Update "Military helmet" effect feedback.

And some other minor fixes as well.

[b]Hope you enjoy it and have a great summer![/b]

notes.title: Full release of Dungeon Core!
notes.notes:
Hey all, 

I've added a new game mode that is unlockable by beating the second boss, Time Trial, where you get to fight your wave through 75 waves of mutants. Kill mutants to collect time & tech. Every once and awhile you'll get a short breather to spend some tech to improve your chances! 

I've spent a lot of time on bug fixes, stability and platform support to support other platforms.

Highlights:
- Time Trial
- Your previously collected tech is now safe in camp while you start a new run. This ensures you can't lose tech but at the same time makes tech valuable for your next run.
- Improve aim assist for controllers.
- Improve rendering of gas (in pits).
- Fix various bugs.

I know that the updates have been infrequent. I'm the only person that has ever worked on Dungeon Core and I also work a full time job. With that said, as the full release is behind me I can now focus on some of that is closer to my heart, namely items that introduces some interesting mechanics, new enemies, new weapons and polish. I'm also looking at different end-game mechanics to make it more interesting and fun for veterans. Next content update will be before summer <3

notes.title: Update 0.9.5.0 - New weapon, new item and more!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

In this patch I've focused on making some of the items & weapons more fun (I've mainly updated the Pulse gun). Some items can now have enemies/terminals marked with a red cross. Marked enemies take 25% more damage. Some of the items interact with marked enemies in different ways.  Every weapon and item added to the game in the future will be unlockable in the shop, from Sewer floor 3, or further.

Update notes:

-Newer items will be unlockable in the shop. They have a 33% chance to appear in the shop starting from Sewer floor 3.
-New weapon Vulkan (unlock at shop).
-Reworked the pulse gun (unlock at shop).
-New item, Sharpshooter (unlock at shop).
-Reworked Scope item.
-Reworked Bluescreen error item.
-Reworked Contract item.
-Reworked Computer Matrix item.
-Reworked Control system item
-Lower price on gun parts.
-Gun parts can now drop from barrels/crate and now have a sound when the drop.
-Gun parts have the same pickup range as tech.
-Energy weapons now dissolves enemies, preventing any "death-attack" (such as sewer squid exploding).
-Doors opens faster after a room is cleared.
-New weapon stat (Full charge bonus). Applicable to all charged weapons.
-New weapon stat (Recharge bullet). Applicable to all non-charged weapons.
-New weapon stat (Piercing ray). Currently only applicable to Pulse gun.
-Bombrat will now instantly explode when dead and not continue charging forward.
-Successfully hacking a teleporter no longer closes it.
-Updated teleporter hacking animations & minimap icon.
-Added a new tech piece worth 100 and another tech piece that only drops when using the "Contract" item.
-The camp will now have a blueish mood light after beating the game.
-Updated some sprites and various small fixes.

I hope you enjoy!

Regards,
Filip

notes.title: Update 0.9.4.6 - Suits, Visor colors, Screen settings
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Back with some more fixes & additions. Now you can unlock some cool suits and visor colors. Look for the red lockers in the camp! I've also added some options (screen settings & audio) and balanced some items.

Update notes:
-Added 2 unlockable suits
-Added unlockable visor colors
-You can now salvage any weapon, even if you currently only hold one.
-Fixed a bug where you could get stuck in loading screen.
-Added audio device options.
-Added resolution, fullscreen & vsync options.
-Fixed a bug where you could abort a reload at the very end.
-Artificial heart projectiles now only deals 33% of its damage vs. terminals
-Every time a projectiles bounces of a wall it loses 50% of its damage vs. terminals (both friendly & hostile projectiles).
-Updated chest sprites to better match the overall theme.

Next up will be some improvements to gun loading mechanics/feedback. I'm also gonna iterate and make some of the current weapons more fun. I also have plans to add 3 new weapons.

Regards
Filip

notes.title: Update 0.9.4.5 - Mobility, quality of life & more
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Got a couple of improvements & bug fixes. I've focused on making the movement more fluid and making the weapons feel more responsive (abort reload). Also buffed two weapons that were under-performing in later parts of the game.

patch notes 0.9.4.5

-You can no longer collect food at full hp
-Fixed a bug where enemies could spawn outside of the room
-Increased walk speed slightly
-Increased shotgun & sawed-off range to make them more viable vs bosses and late-game
-Fixed (reduced) the bomb area from the ink bombs (first boss)
-Adjusted enemy hit boxes
-Steam rich presence (Steam friends list can display statuses like "In sewers floor 3")
-You can now interrupt weapon reload to fire your second weapon
-Fixed a bug where your weapon wouldn't fire
-Removed movement penalty after phase-walking
-Phase-walk is now faster but with shorter duration (you'll cover the same distance but regain control faster)
-Bullets from "Ghost bullet" item are now yellow to reduce confusion.

Regards,
Filip

notes.title: Small update - 0.9.4.2
notes.notes:
Hi all!

I've focused on the most urgent technical issues the first few days after launch. I've gotten a lot of great feedback and I do look through it all! 

The first update includes:
-Audio volume issues
-Black screen on startup (only some users were affected)
-Mine no longer hurt the player
-Rockets no longer hurt the player (from the Rocket Bullet item)
-Clarified some of the item descriptions
-Minor movement issues
-Decreased animation time in death screen just a little

I see that a lot of people want to be able to rebind keys, I'll get right on that :) As a solo dev, I can only work on one bit at a time, so I will prioritize the stuff that most of you guys ask for.

First I'll fix any startup/technical issues so that everyone has a chance to try it out. Then I'd love to get back into creating more items, weapons, enemies and all of that good stuff.

Regards,
Filip
